open_decisions.detail: Four formal literatures apply to this product and none has been opened across nine ADRs: certain-vs-possible answers in incomplete-information databases (ADR-0005's outcome pair is a folk re-derivation), transaction isolation and phantom reads (UNQ001 is phantom-prone by construction and may return conforms over a workspace holding a duplicate), unseen-population estimation (ADR-0005 decision 3 asserts an unbounded gap cannot be sized without consulting the field that sizes unobserved populations), and entity resolution (where issue #31's defect is a standard result).
open_decisions.unseen_population_ANSWERED: SWEPT 2026-08-17, recorded at docs/research/unseen-population-sizing.md. ADR-0005 decision 3 SURVIVES, and its stated reason should be replaced rather than kept. The field agrees no upper bound is available in the general case (Alfo, Bohning & Rocchetti 2020, DOI 10.1111/biom.13265; Mao, Huang & Zhang 2016, DOI 10.1111/biom.12553). Every estimator that does produce a bound -- Chao1, ACE, jackknife, Good-Turing, Horvitz-Thompson -- runs on a FREQUENCY-OF-FREQUENCIES distribution and needs the same unit observed more than once. Cursor pagination returns each child exactly once, so singletons equal n and doubletons are zero by construction: the input does not exist. These estimators also assume the miss is RANDOM; a cursor stops at a deterministic prefix. UUIDv4 IDs rule out the serial-number family. NEW REVISIT-IF: two independent enumerations of one scope over identifiable IDs WOULD give a frequency-of-frequencies distribution -- the project has two paths, block-children and POST /v1/search (#24). DO NOT USE IT: both share one permission grant, so the lists are positively dependent, and positive dependence biases the estimate DOWN, reporting a SMALLER gap than the true gap. That is the flattering direction and the product's own false-green class inside the coverage instrument. Incidental: Bar-Ilan & Peritz 2009 DOI 10.1002/asi.21097 independently reaches ADR-0006's 'partition the declared root' remedy. Four of eight quotes verified against Crossref abstracts; four rest on a Wiley retrieval tool and are marked unverified in the file. ACM and IEEE venues NOT CHECKED, not absent.
open_decisions.next: Rule-by-rule soundness classification: sound / sound-with-hypotheses / not soundly implementable against this API. Three of the four named literatures remain unopened -- incomplete-information databases, transaction isolation and phantom reads, entity resolution (partly closed by ADR-0010). Operator framing: soundness is what buyers pay for, and free linters are free because they are unsound.

unq001_design_S029.q1_empty_value: An empty value is NOT a value for uniqueness. No finding, and it STAYS IN THE DENOMINATOR - the resource was read and its pairs were genuinely evaluated. Emptiness changes the comparison predicate, never the coverage arithmetic. Revisit if a scope needs two blanks to collide (a slug, an external key): a per-declaration flag, not a default change.
unq001_design_S029.q2_granularity: ONE FINDING PER OFFENDING RESOURCE. ADR-0010:145 already anchors UNQ001 on 'The page'; :153 states the table presumes per-resource emission and that per-group needs a group anchor the ADR does not supply; :211 delegates the choice to this ticket. Per-resource costs no ADR, per-group costs one, and #59 states it needs none. Five identical rows are FIVE findings over TEN evaluated pairs. The ticket's own comment claiming the denominator follows from granularity is WRONG - ADR-0011 decision 2 fixes it independently.
unq001_design_S029.q3_materialisation: NOT NAMED BY THE TICKET. scan.ts:170-174 marks evaluated by iterating manifest.of(rule.unit), so entries under a pair-shaped unit have to BE pairs. Materialise C(n,2), and REFUSE a scope above a stated ceiling rather than silently degrade to a resource denominator. Proposed ceiling 1000 resources = 499500 pairs. Revisit if a real config exceeds it: a streaming counter, which means changing the evaluated intersection - a blast radius #59 should not carry.
unq001_design_S029.hazard_2_value_redaction: The duplicated value is NEVER printed, in any mode, including --show-titles. The finding names the co-participants by ID. REQ001 sets the precedent at req001.ts:229-233. Comparison is by TRIMMED string and is NOT case-folded - case-folding is inferred policy, which ADR-0001 decision 4 rejects.
unq001_design_S029.baseline_on_deletion: A and B share a value; each carries its own finding under its own anchor. Delete B: A is unique so its finding is absent, B's anchor is gone so its finding is absent. Both resolve independently, matching never crosses an anchor (ADR-0010 decision 1), and no transitive closure is taken over the group.
